macros.name: CBPageBrk
macros.doc: \CBPageBrk forces a new page if \ifChordBk is true.

macros.name: CBPageBrk
macros.doc: \CBPageBrk forces a new page if \ifChordBk is true.

macros.name: ChBassFont
macros.doc: \ChBassFont sets the font for the bass note in chords as printed by the \Ch, \Chr and \ChX commands.

macros.name: ChBkFont
macros.doc: \ChBkFont sets the font for square brackets typeset inside \Ch commands (and its variants).

macros.name: ChFont
macros.doc: \ChFont sets the font for chords as printed by the \Ch, \Chr, and \ChX commands.

macros.name: Chr
macros.doc: this command performs the same function as the \Ch command with one exception: the \Chr command inserts a rule, at the height specified by the \SBRuleRaiseAmount macro, when the chord is wider than the syllable.

macros.name: ChX
macros.doc: this command performs the same function as the \Ch command with one exception: the \ChX command causes spaces trailing the command to be ignored.

macros.name: CpyRtFont
macros.doc: \CpyRtFont sets the font used to print the copyright line produced by the \CpyRt command.

macros.name: CpyRtInfoFont
macros.doc: \CpyRtInfoFont sets the font used to print the copyright licensing information parameter of the \song environment; which appears after the copyright information parameter under the song title.

macros.name: CSColBrk
macros.doc: \CSColBrk generates a column break here if we’re in compactsong mode.

macros.name: FLineIdx
macros.doc: \FLineIdx{⟨first line⟩} make an entry in the Title & First Line Index file, “jobname .tIdx.”

macros.name: HangAmt
macros.doc: The indent amount for lines that are too long is set using the \HangAmt command.

macros.name: LeftMarginSBBracket
macros.doc: \LeftMarginSBBracket is the amount of left margin to leave when the \SBBracket environment is in effect.

macros.name: LeftMarginSBChorus
macros.doc: \LeftMarginSBChorus is the amount of left margin to leave when the \SBChorus environment is in effect.

macros.name: LeftMarginSBSection
macros.doc: \LeftMarginSBSection is the amount of left margin to leave when the \SBSection environment is in effect.

macros.name: LeftMarginSBVerse
macros.doc: \LeftMarginSBVerse is the amount of left margin to leave when the \SBVerse environment is in effect.

macros.name: makeArtistIndex
macros.doc: \makeArtistIndex starts creation of an index of songs by artist (composer).

macros.name: makeKeyIndex
macros.doc: \makeKeyIndex starts creation of an index of songs by key.

macros.name: makeTitleContents
macros.doc: \makeTitleContents starts creation of a table of contents.

macros.name: makeTitleContentsSkip
macros.doc: \makeTitleContentsSkip starts creation of a table of contents of songs excluded from the songbook.

macros.name: makeTitleIndex
macros.doc: \makeTitleIndex starts creation of a title and first line index.

macros.name: NotWOPageBrk
macros.doc: \NotWOPageBrk forces a new page if \ifWordsOnly is false.

macros.name: OHContPgFtr
macros.doc: \OHContPgFtr prints a page heading continuation footer on overheads; this macro must be manually inserted where needed.

macros.name: OHContPgHdr
macros.doc: \OHContPgHdr prints a page heading continuation header on overheads; this macro must be manually inserted where needed.

macros.name: OHPageBrk
macros.doc: \OHPageBrk forces a new page if \ifOverhead is true.

macros.name: SBBaseLang
macros.doc: \SBBaseLang tag is the name of the language of all songs not specified within an songTranslation environment, and also as the default value of the songTranslation environment’s optional song language parameter.

macros.name: sbBaselineSkipAmt
macros.doc: The value of \sbBaselineSkipAmt is recalculated immediately before each being used in each hanging indent list.

macros.name: SBBracketTagFont
macros.doc: \SBBracketTagFont sets the font used to create the tag for an SBBracket environment.

macros.name: SBBridgeTag
macros.doc: The \SBBridgeTag tag is inserted before the start of a bridge.

macros.name: SBBridgeTagFont
macros.doc: \SBBridgeTagFont sets the font used to create the tag for an SBBridge environment.

macros.name: SBChordRaise
macros.doc: \SBChordRaise is the distance to raise the chords above the baseline of the text they sit over.

macros.name: SBChorusTag
macros.doc: The \SBChorusTag tag is inserted before the first line of a chorus.

macros.name: SBChorusTagFont
macros.doc: \SBChorusTagFont sets the font used to print the chorus tag, \SBChorusTag.

macros.name: SBContinueMark
macros.doc: conditionally produce a continuation symbol.

macros.name: SBContinueTag
macros.doc: The \SBContinueTag tag is inserted in an \SBContinueMark.

macros.name: SBDefaultFont
macros.doc: \SBDefaultFont sets the default font for the songbook.

macros.name: SBem
macros.doc: \SBem prints an em-dash (i.e., “—”) when \WordsOnly is \False.

macros.name: SBen
macros.doc: \SBen prints an en-dash (i.e., “–”) when \WordsOnly is \False.

macros.name: SBEndTag
macros.doc: The \SBEndTag tag is inserted before the start of an ending (in an \SBEnd command).

macros.name: SBEndTagFont
macros.doc: \SBEndTagFont sets the font used to print the tag, \SBEndTag, for the \SBEnd command.

macros.name: SBIntersyllableRule
macros.doc: The \SBIntersyllableRule tag is actually the command(s) used to draw the rule between adjoining syllables.

macros.name: SBIntro
macros.doc: \SBIntro[⟨use in words-only⟩]{⟨the introduction⟩} is used to encapsulate any introduction to a song: it causes hthe introductioni to be set with an intro tag of “Intro:”, using in the \SBIntroTagFont font.

macros.name: SBIntro
macros.doc: \SBIntro[⟨use in words-only⟩]{⟨the introduction⟩} is used to encapsulate any introduction to a song: it causes hthe introductioni to be set with an intro tag of “Intro:”, using in the \SBIntroTagFont font.

macros.name: SBIntroTag
macros.doc: The \SBIntroTag tag is inserted before the start of an introduction (in an \SBIntro command).

macros.name: SBIntroTagFont
macros.doc: \SBIntroTagFont sets the font used to print the introduction tag, \SBIntroTag.

macros.name: SBLyricNoteFont
macros.doc: \SBLyricNoteFont sets the font used in comments placed within the lyrics giving musical direction.

macros.name: SBMargNote
macros.doc: \SBMargNote{⟨marginal note⟩} is used to place a note of some kind in the margin of a songbook.

macros.name: SBOccursBrktFont
macros.doc: \SBOccursBrktFont sets the font used to create the large left and right square brackets which delimit an SBOccurs environment.

macros.name: SBOccursTagFont
macros.doc: \SBOccursTagFont sets the font used to create the \SBOccurs tag.

macros.name: SBOHContTagFont
macros.doc: \SBOHContTagFont sets the font used to print the \OHContPgFtr and \OHContPgHdr.

macros.name: SBPubDom
macros.doc: The \SBPubDom tag is used to indicate that a song is in the public domain.

macros.name: SBRef
macros.doc: \SBRef{⟨book title⟩}{⟨page or song number⟩} creates a reference in the margin to another music book, or tape.

macros.name: SBRefFont
macros.doc: \SBRefFont sets the font used in the marginal reference printed by the \SBRef command.

macros.name: SBRuleRaiseAmount
macros.doc: \SBRuleRaiseAmount is the distance to raise the rule (as specified by \SBIntersyllableRule) which fills the space between adjoining syllables.

macros.name: SBSectionNumberFont
macros.doc: \SBSectionNumberFont sets the font used to print the \SBSectionCnt in front of sections in an SBSection environment.

macros.name: sbSetsbBaselineSkipAmt
macros.doc: \sbSetsbBaselineSkipAmt sets the \sbBaselineSkipAmt length.

macros.name: SBtocSEntry
macros.doc: \SBtocSEntry is the macro that encloses each skipped song TOC entry.

macros.name: SBUnknownTag
macros.doc: The \SBUnknownTag tag is used with the \WAndM command and is the string to insert when either the author/artist or the copyright holder is unknown.

macros.name: SBVerseNumberFont
macros.doc: \SBVerseNumberFont sets the font used to print the \SBVerseCnt in front of verses in an SBVerse environment.

macros.name: ScriptRef
macros.doc: \ScriptRef{⟨scripture address⟩} is a scripture reference for the song.

macros.name: ScriptRef
macros.doc: \ScriptRef{⟨scripture address⟩} is a scripture reference for the song.

macros.name: ScriptRefFont
macros.doc: \ScriptRefFont sets the font used to print the scripture reference generated by the \ScriptRef command.

macros.name: SpaceAboveSTitle
macros.doc: \SpaceAboveSTitle is the amount of vertical space left by the STitle command before it prints the song title line.

macros.name: SpaceAfterChorus
macros.doc: \SpaceAfterChorus is the vertical space to leave after an SBChorus environment.

macros.name: SpaceAfterOpGroup
macros.doc: \SpaceAfterOpGroup is the vertical space to leave after an SBOpGroup environment.

macros.name: SpaceAfterSBBracket
macros.doc: \SpaceAfterSBBracket is the vertical space to leave after an SBBracket environment.

macros.name: SpaceAfterSection
macros.doc: \SpaceAfterSection is the vertical space to leave after an SBSection environment.

macros.name: SpaceAfterSong
macros.doc: \SpaceAfterSong is the vertical space to leave after a song.

macros.name: SpaceAfterTitleBlk
macros.doc: \SpaceAfterTitleBlk is the space inserted by the song environment between the title block and the versicles.

macros.name: SpaceAfterVerse
macros.doc: \SpaceAfterVerse is the vertical space to leave after an SBVerse environment.

macros.name: SpaceBeforeSBBracket
macros.doc: \SpaceBeforeSBBracket is the vertical space to leave before an SBBracket.

macros.name: STitleFont
macros.doc: \STitleFont sets the font used to print the song title, as generated by the \STitle command.

macros.name: STitleKeyFont
macros.doc: \STitleKeyFont sets the font used to print the key a song is written in, as generated by the \STitle command.

macros.name: STitleMarkboth
macros.doc: \STitleMarkboth hook to allow \STitle’s \markboth to be overridden.

macros.name: STitleNumberFont
macros.doc: \STitleNumberFont sets the font used to print the \SBSongCnt in front of the song title, as generated by the \STitle command.

macros.name: titleIndex

arg.snippet: titleIndex{${1:song title or first line}}{${2:song number}}

macros.doc: \titleIndex[h1 i][h2 i] makes an entry in the title & first line index.

macros.name: WandMFont
macros.doc: \WandMFont sets the font used to print the lyricist and composer line generated by the \WandM command.

macros.name: WBPageBrk
macros.doc: \WBPageBrk forces a new page if \ifWordBk is true.

macros.name: WOPageBrk
macros.doc: \WOPageBrk forces a new page if \ifWordsOnly is true.

envs.name: SBChorus
envs.doc: \begin{SBChorus}h. . . the chorus. . . i\end{SBChorus} is the environment to wrap around a chorus that you wish to be indented and given a chorus tag (“Ch:”).

envs.name: SBChorus*
envs.doc: \begin{SBChorus}h. . . the chorus. . . i\end{SBChorus} is the environment to wrap around a chorus that you wish to be indented and given a chorus tag (“Ch:”).

envs.name: SBExtraKeys
envs.doc: \begin{SBExtraKeys}{⟨song content⟩}\end{SBExtraKeys} is the environment used when you wish to list the song again in another key.

envs.name: song

arg.snippet: [${1:include or compact}]{${2:song title}}{${3:key}}{${4:copyright information}}{${5:composer and lyricist}}{${6:scripture reference}}{${7:copyright licensing information}}

envs.doc: The song environment takes care of making index entries, incrementing \SBSongCnt and page generation (if necessary).

envs.name: song

arg.snippet: {${1:song title}}{${2:key}}{${3:copyright information}}{${4:composer and lyricist}}{${5:scripture reference}}{${6:copyright licensing information}}

envs.doc: The song environment takes care of making index entries, incrementing \SBSongCnt and page generation (if necessary).

envs.name: songTranslation
envs.doc: The songTranslation environment always occurs within a song environment; it resets the verse counter, causes the title and other parameter information to be displayed, and makes the appropriate index and table of contents entries.
